notes.title: It Has My Face is like survival horror Minecraft, where you're the killer
notes.notes:
Many moons ago, I read a book about the concept of 'The Devil.' Is he a little horned, goat-legged guy who likes to cause chaos? Or is he that eerie feeling in the back of your mind; the one that tells you to mess things up and see what happens. It certainly gave me a lot to think about (I read it at least ten years ago now), and It Has My Face, a new horror game published by Dead by Daylight's Behaviour Interactive, has brought it back to the forefront of my mind.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: New Partnership with Behaviour Interactive Announced
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

 We have very exciting news to share today: [b]we just announced a publishing partnership with Behaviour Interactive to bring our game, It Has My Face, to life![/b] We had the pleasure to reveal the news during the PAX East live broadcast earlier today, during which we also announced an [b]Early Access launch coming in 2025.[/b]

[b]We're stoked about what the future holds for It Has My Face, and we can't wait to share more news with you soon. In the meantime, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2538290/It_Has_My_Face_Demo/]go ahead and hunt your clones in the Demo[/url], and don't forget to wishlist the game![/b]


You can also watch the latest Announcement Trailer here (now updated with our new name!):

[url=https://youtu.be/BydQFpvdsGA]https://youtu.be/BydQFpvdsGA[/url]


Happy Clone hunting!

notes.title: DoubleWe has a new name: It Has My Face!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve got some exciting news! DoubleWe has a new name: It Has My Face!

We believe that the new name fits the game better. It’s weird, a little unsettling, and matches the tone we’re going for. Along with the name, we've updated the main artwork too. The new look gives a clearer sense of what the game actually feels like to play.

Nothing else is changing. Same team, same game, just a better name and a better capsule.

Thanks for sticking with us!

- wolderado

notes.title: It’s you versus yourself in the demo for roguelite clone-hunter DoubleWe
notes.notes:
I adore the premise of DoubleWe: you’re given a randomised appearance, dumped in a cramped sci-fi shithole full of dodgy-looking NPCs, and forced to find kill your identical clone before he can emerge from the crowd and shank you first. There’s a demo for Steam Next Fest, and it’s provoked in me some of the most pulse-quickening paranoia since the days of DayZ.

Read more

notes.title: New Demo Available during February Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]

We're excited to announce that a brand-new demo will be available during February Next Fest! This special demo features an entirely new mysterious story ending, fresh new mutators, and a host of improvements based on player feedback.

[h2]What’s New in the Demo?[/h2]
🔥 New Story Content – Uncover a brand-new ending that features a sneak peek into the full game!
🛠️ Gameplay Enhancements – Improved mechanics, Relaxed game mode, and smoother gameplay.
🎭 New Mutators – Experience 3 new mutators (Darkness, Paranoia, Hitman) and more in the release version!

Join us during the February Next Fest and be among the first to experience these exciting changes! Your feedback is invaluable, so don’t forget to wishlist the game and share your thoughts with us.

Also, there will be a pre-recorded video of me playing and commenting on the demo. Feel free to drop by!

See you at the Next Fest!

-wolderado

notes.title: Demo Available NOW!!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
For the first time ever, we're releasing a public demo of our game, DoubleWe! Ready your knife because your clone is waiting for you!

Last time the game was published was 4 years ago in a game jam. I've been working on this game for a long time so it's very exciting! If you encounter any issues or bugs, let me know!

The demo features:
[list]
[*] Core gameplay loop
[*] Many, many NPCs roaming around
[*] Multiple weapons and ways to kill your clone
[*] Officer NPCs that attack anyone with a potential for aggression
[*] A complex generated AI for your killer clone. No clone will act the same between rounds!
[/list]


Demo will be available for August 17 to 20. But we'll have more demos in the future!

Happy clone hunting!
-wolderado
